capabilities.purpose: Generate and retrieve SealSeek media through the calling Agent

side_effects.authorization: Generation is authorized by the user request; provider routing is configured in the calling Agent.
side_effects.private_state: Local prompts, task records and account-scoped reference review cache

side_effects.authorization: Generation is authorized by the user request; provider routing is configured in the calling Agent.

capabilities.purpose: Authorize the current user through the fixed official PLUGIN channel with SMS login

side_effects.authorization: Human explicitly requests login or removal of credentials.
side_effects.private_state: Managed credential profile and recoverable backups

archive.none_effect: Skip visible element archival; provider canvas/task history still required.

placement.explicit_positions: One x/y and optional width/height object per requested output; canvas units.
placement.grid_effect: Explicitly reflow all CLI-owned elements; preserve unrelated positions.

import_fields.idempotency: Stable id/output index; changed URL returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

canvas_contract.suggested_standalone_workflow: Reuse conversation canvas and append; caller may override.

schema.media: canvas add media entries with frameId and explicit placement

batch.idempotency: stable frame/media IDs; conflicting bounds or URLs are rejected

element_placement.input: array of id,x,y,width,height and optional expected bounds
element_placement.preserves: element identity, Frame membership, media URL, metadata
element_placement.recovery: query same canvas; repeat same placements; previous bounds checked unless already applied

file_management.destination: Existing flat project/folder ID or root; projects and folders share IDs.
file_management.backup: Private metadata and content before mutation; backup path returned.
file_management.verification: Read back title, folder ownership and unchanged content.
file_management.idempotency: Already-applied title or destination returns changed:false without mutation.
file_management.recovery: Inspect the same canvas after uncertain outcomes; no automatic replay.

project_management.create_recovery: Intent before POST; remote ID before readback; reuse ID/name without another POST; unresolved creation blocks replay.
project_management.rename_recovery: Private metadata backup and verified readback by the same folder ID.
project_management.side_effects: Creates a project or changes its name; no media generation or automatic canvas move.

host_resolution.requirements: Node.js >=22, CLI execution, structured JSON and delivery-file access; verify in the current host.
host_resolution.installation: Other Agents resolve their own Skill directory and pass --path. Names are adapter preferences, not a host allowlist.

automatic_update.trigger: ordinary task entry (including capabilities); excludes skill/version/help/task/internal workers
automatic_update.local_skill_check: each enabled ordinary entry, independent of registry cache and package-version changes

target.scope: selected existing managed Skill only; custom Agent names use generic adapter
target.unspecified: no Skill directories scanned or synchronized

ffprobe.recovery: Install package with optional dependencies enabled; or configure a working ffprobe executable. Inspect the same task after repair.

installationLifecycle.install: Resolve own directory; skill install --agent AGENT --path EXACT_SKILL_DIR --json
installationLifecycle.update: Resolve selected target first; update install --yes --path EXACT_SKILL_DIR --json
installationLifecycle.verification: Local runtime version, managed hashes, then host-native discovery

automaticUpdates.trigger: ordinary task entry; excludes help/version/source/task polling
automaticUpdates.installation: explicit standing authorization; compatible stable version only
automaticUpdates.recovery: update operation and resume reuse verified candidate

dependencies setup.output: Verify package-managed ffprobe; restore its executable bit on POSIX when install scripts were blocked.
